title: Property Lead Qualification Voice Agent
summary: Call every new portal, ad and website enquiry within minutes in Hindi, English or Hinglish, qualify budget, configuration and timeline, and pass warm leads to presales with a summary.

seo.title: Property Lead Qualification Voice Agent | VipraTech
seo.description: AI voice agent that calls new property enquiries in Hindi and English, qualifies budget, configuration and timeline, and books site visits or hands over.
keywords: Hindi voice bot for real estate

problem.intro: A launch campaign can bring hundreds of enquiries a day from property portals, Meta lead forms, Google ads and the project website. Presales teams call them as time allows, many leads are not reached while their interest is fresh, and the first conversation is spent on the same questions each time.

pain_points.title: Slow first call
pain_points.detail: Leads that arrive at night, on weekends or during a campaign spike wait hours or days for a call, by which time they have spoken to other projects.

pain_points.title: Low-intent leads take up presales time
pain_points.detail: Many enquiries turn out to be brokers, wrong numbers, people outside the budget or renters, and each takes a call to discover.

pain_points.title: Inconsistent answers
pain_points.detail: Different callers quote different starting prices, possession dates and offers, some of which do not match the RERA registration or approved collateral.

pain_points.title: Thin CRM notes
pain_points.detail: Call outcomes are entered as one word, so the next caller or site sales manager starts from scratch.

solution.overview: We build a voice agent that calls each new enquiry soon after it arrives, within the calling windows you set, introduces itself as the developer's AI assistant and holds a natural conversation in Hindi, English or Hinglish. It confirms the project, configuration and budget, whether the buyer plans to live in the home or invest, the timeline, home-loan needs and preferred visit dates. It answers factual questions only from an approved project fact sheet: RERA number, location, configurations, carpet areas, amenities and the declared possession date. Qualified buyers get a site visit booked or a warm transfer to presales, and the CRM receives the transcript, a summary and a score.
capabilities: Outbound calling of new leads from portals, Meta and Google lead forms and the website, within set windows
Natural conversation in Hindi, English and Hinglish, with regional languages where testing supports them
Qualification on configuration, budget, purpose, timeline, loan need and location preference
Answers grounded in an approved project fact sheet, including the RERA registration number
Site visit booking, or warm transfer to a presales executive during working hours
CRM update with transcript, structured fields, lead score and next action

workflow.title: Receive the lead
workflow.detail: A new enquiry arrives in the CRM from a portal, ad form or website, and duplicate or opted-out numbers are filtered.

workflow.title: Place the call
workflow.detail: The agent calls within the configured window, identifies itself as an AI assistant and confirms the enquiry.

workflow.title: Qualify and answer
workflow.detail: It asks qualification questions and answers factual queries from the approved fact sheet only.

workflow.title: Decide the next step
workflow.detail: Based on fit and intent, it books a site visit, offers a callback or marks the lead as not suitable, with the reason.

workflow.title: Hand over warm leads
workflow.detail: High-intent buyers, price negotiations and complex questions are transferred to presales with a short summary.

workflow.title: Update the CRM
workflow.detail: Transcript, structured answers, score and next action are written to the lead record.

inputs: New leads from portals, Meta and Google lead forms and the website
Approved project fact sheet and FAQs
Presales roster and site visit slots
outputs: Structured qualification fields in the CRM
Daily report by lead source and outcome
human_in_the_loop: Presales executives take every warm transfer and handle price, discount and negotiation. The sales head approves the fact sheet and script before go-live and again after every price or offer change.
integrations: Real estate CRM such as Salesforce, LeadSquared or Sell.Do
Cloud telephony such as Exotel, Knowlarity or Twilio
Property portal and Meta lead form feeds
WhatsApp Business API for visit confirmations
Google Calendar or the CRM's scheduling module
guardrails: Discloses that it is an AI assistant at the start of every call
Quotes no final prices, discounts or offers beyond the approved fact sheet
Makes no claims about appreciation, rental yield or investment returns
Never states a possession date other than the one declared in the RERA registration
Respects calling windows, DND preferences and opt-out requests
compliance_notes: Outbound calling is configured to respect TRAI commercial communication rules and your customer consent records.
Call recordings and transcripts are personal data under the DPDP Act 2023 and follow agreed retention periods.
Statements about the project stay consistent with its RERA registration details.

pilot.scope: One project's new leads from one or two sources, called by the agent, alongside a control group handled by presales as usual.
deliverables: Approved call script and project fact sheet
Working voice agent in Hindi and English connected to your CRM
Warm transfer and site visit booking flow

what_we_measure.how: Minutes from lead creation to first connected call, agent group versus control group.
Presales review of a sample of agent-qualified leads against their own follow-up call.
Visits booked by the agent and their attendance, tracked in the CRM.
Transcript review for any off-script price, possession date or returns statement.

faqs.q: Will buyers know they are speaking to AI?
faqs.a: Yes. The agent says so at the start of the call and offers a callback from a person if the buyer prefers. Its voice and pace are tuned to sound natural, but it never pretends to be human.

Hindi, English and Hinglish as standard. Marathi, Gujarati, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada and other languages are added where speech models perform well enough in testing, using real recordings from your market before go-live.

faqs.q: What if the buyer asks about price or discounts?
faqs.a: It shares only the approved starting price or price range, and only if the sales head allows it. Discount and negotiation questions are transferred to presales. It never invents offers.

Typically a one-time build and integration fee plus a running cost per minute or per call that depends on telephony and model usage. The pilot gives you a measured cost per qualified lead before you commit.
